items.name: SUB · Price history
items.what: Researcher tool: this week's vs last week's supplier price per product, each with a source.
setup: Select your Google Sheets OAuth2 credential in Supplier prices and replace YOUR_SHEET_ID.
Add a price_last_week column to the 3.4 Supplier prices tab and fill it with last week's prices (copy price into it once a week).
Save the workflow and note its ID.
items.test: Execute: one item with found: true and an items list of product, price_now, price_last_week and source.

items.name: SUB · Top sellers
items.what: Researcher tool: the five best-selling products over the last 7 days from Orders.
setup: Select your Google Sheets OAuth2 credential in Read Orders and replace YOUR_SHEET_ID.
Save the workflow and note its ID.
items.test: Execute: top_sellers lists up to five products with units_sold, counted from orders created in the last 7 days.

items.name: HL · Newsletter team (4.7)
items.what: Monday 06:00 researcher → code check → writer → editor pipeline with at most two revision rounds, ending in a Gmail draft to Tolu.
setup: Import SUB · Price history and SUB · Top sellers first.
Create an OpenAI credential and select it in Small model (temp 0), Writer model (strong) and Editor model. Replace YOUR_SMALL_MODEL, YOUR_STRONG_MODEL and YOUR_EDITOR_MODEL.
In get_price_history and get_top_sellers, replace YOUR_PRICE_HISTORY_WORKFLOW_ID and YOUR_TOP_SELLERS_WORKFLOW_ID by choosing the sub-workflows from the list.
Select your Telegram API credential in Alert Tolu and replace YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
Create a Gmail OAuth2 credential, select it in Gmail draft to Tolu, and replace tolu@harvestlane.example with Tolu's address.
Open Settings → Error workflow and choose HL · Error alerts. Publish (activate) when happy.
items.test: Click Execute workflow. The Researcher returns structured items, Check research passes, and a draft "This week at the market (date)" appears in Gmail Drafts. To see the cap, temporarily add "Never approve" to the editor's message: you get exactly two revisions and a draft whose subject starts with "⚠ Needs a human look".

walk.title: Build it: the newsletter team
walk.sample: Week of 2026-10-05 · Tomatoes ₦10,400 → ₦12,500 · top sellers from Orders

steps.say: Every Monday at six, the team wakes up. By the time Tolu has breakfast, a draft is waiting.
Agent one, the researcher, collects facts only. Every price must come from a tool result with its source. No opinions, no advice.
show: Collect facts only. Every price must come from a tool result

steps.say: Lookups don't need a big brain. A small model at temperature zero is cheap and steady.
Its first tool reads this week's and last week's supplier prices. Read-only, no input, so it can't change a single price.
The second tool counts the five best sellers from the last seven days of orders. Again, it only reads.
The hand-off is a contract, not a chat. This parser forces the research into a fixed shape: product, price now, price last week, and source.
Before anyone writes, code checks every item has both prices and a source, and recalculates the change percentage itself. The model's maths is overwritten.
If the facts fail, nothing gets written. Tolu gets a Telegram alert listing the problems, and the run stops.
Agent two, the writer, has no tools and a stronger model. Its brief: warm, practical, one eighty to two fifty words, using only numbers from the research.
show: Use only numbers from the research

steps.say: Agent three, the editor, checks the draft against a four-point checklist, not make it better. It returns a verdict: approved true or false, and a list of issues.
show: 3 no advice beyond buying tips · 4 tone

steps.say: If it isn't approved, the writer gets its draft plus the editor's issues, and rewrites. Then the editor checks again.
Round two is the last. The rounds are drawn as separate nodes, so the cap is impossible to miss. No endless back and forth.
After that, whatever the verdict, the draft goes to a human. If it's still not approved, the subject is flagged and the editor's issues sit at the top.
show: Subject: ⚠ Needs a human look: This week at the market

steps.say: And it's a Gmail draft, never an automatic send. Tolu reads it, tweaks it, and presses send herself.
steps.data: 1 draft · This week at the market (2026-10-05)

walk.end: Three agents, two rounds at most, one draft in Tolu's inbox: her Sunday night is now a five-minute Monday read.
